title: Ineq-Comp: Benchmarking Human-Intuitive Compositional Reasoning in Automated Theorem Proving on Inequalities
authors_zh: Haoyu Zhao, Yihan Geng, Shange Tang, Yong Lin, Bohan Lyu, Hongzhou Lin, Chi Jin, Sanjeev Arora
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** A 375-task Lean benchmark created by controlled transformations of elementary inequalities to test composition.
375 个从基础不等式受控变换得到的 Lean 任务，专门测组合泛化。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Current Lean provers can solve many individual classical inequalities yet may not learn human-intuitive composition. After variable duplication, algebraic rewriting, or multi-step combination of simple facts, the theorem remains straightforward to humans but prover success drops. Ordinary benchmarks cannot separate memorized theorem patterns from recombination of known components.

Ineq-Comp generates controlled variants from elementary inequalities and includes real problems and constituent-proof conditions to diagnose compositional generalization in formal proving.

现有 Lean prover 能证明许多单个经典不等式，却可能没有学会人类直觉中的组合原则：复制变量、代数等价改写或把多个简单结论串联后，形式目标仍然成立，但模型成功率显著下降。普通 benchmark 难以区分模型是在记忆常见 theorem，还是能把已掌握构件重新组合。

Ineq-Comp 从基础不等式系统生成受控变体，并提供真实题与组件 proof 条件，专门诊断形式证明的组合泛化。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The official Apache-2.0 Parquet release contains 375 Lean inequality tasks: 75 each in seed, type1, and type2, 100 mix items, and 50 real problems. Type1 emphasizes variable duplication and reparameterization, type2 algebraic rewriting, and mix composes several elementary inequalities. The repository also provides seed proofs and evaluation scripts. Formal statements and Lean proof success are the core objects, making this an evaluation and verifier-guided-search resource rather than a large SFT corpus.

官方 Parquet 数据含 375 个 Lean 不等式任务：seed、type1、type2 各 75，mix 100，real 50，采用 Apache-2.0。type1 主要复制与重参数化变量，type2 进行代数改写，mix 组合多条基础不等式；仓库另提供 seed proof 和评测脚本。每条任务以 formal statement 和 Lean proof success 为核心，适合 benchmark 与 verifier-guided search，不是大规模 SFT 语料。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build seed problems: Collect AM-GM, Cauchy, and other elementary inequalities as Lean statements with compiling seed proofs.
  1. Generate controlled transformations: Use variable duplication, symbol substitution, and algebraic equivalence to create type1/type2 tasks while keeping human mathematical difficulty similar.
  1. Construct compositions: Ineq-Mix combines several elementary results into multi-step goals, while 50 real inequalities reduce fully synthetic distribution bias.
  1. Execute proof evaluation: Models generate Lean proofs under pass@k and kernel compilation determines success. Constituent proofs are also supplied in context to isolate composition from missing knowledge.

1. 建立基础题： 收集 AM-GM、Cauchy 和其他初等不等式，写成 Lean statement，并提供可编译 seed proof。
  1. 生成受控变换： 通过变量复制、符号替换、代数等价改写生成 type1/type2，使数学难度近似不变而表面结构改变。
  1. 构造组合题： Ineq-Mix 将多个基础结论拼接为多步目标；另加入 50 道真实不等式，减少完全合成分布偏差。
  1. 执行证明评测： 模型按 pass@k 生成 Lean proof，内核编译决定成功；实验还把组件 proof 放入上下文，检查失败是否来自组合而非知识缺失。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Most provers degrade substantially from seed to transformed and composed splits. DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B is the most robust yet still drops by about 20% at pass@32. Performance remains poor even when formal proofs of the constituent parts are placed in context, indicating a failure to organize known lemmas rather than merely missing them. This supports the composition diagnosis, but 375 inequality tasks cannot represent all theorem proving.
多数 prover 在变换和组合 split 上相对 seed 明显退化；DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 最稳健，但 pass@32 仍下降约 20%。即使把组成部分的形式 proof 放入上下文，模型整体表现仍低，说明瓶颈不只是不会基础 lemma，而是无法组织它们。该证据支持组合诊断，但 375 题和不等式领域不足以代表全部 theorem proving。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Formal-proof benchmarks usually group naturally sourced problems by difficulty, making it unclear what changed between tasks. Ineq-Comp starts from the same seeds and alters only variable structure, algebraic representation, or composition depth, producing more causal diagnostic splits. The novelty is controlled structural transformation and the counterfactual constituent-proof experiment, not a new prover.
形式证明 benchmark 通常按自然来源和难度分组，难以控制题目之间究竟改变了什么。Ineq-Comp 以同一 seed 为基点，只改变变量结构、代数表示或组合深度，从而形成因果更清楚的诊断 split。新意是受控结构变换和“给出组件 proof”的反事实实验，不是新的 prover。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Narrow scope: Only 375 tasks are included, focused on elementary real inequalities; degradation may not transfer to algebra, topology, or program verification.
  1. Generator bias: Fixed transformations can create recognizable templates, allowing targeted training to improve scores without general composition.
  1. Pass@k budget: Different sampling counts, temperatures, or Lean versions make results incomparable; reproduction must fix the full search budget.

1. 范围较窄： 数据只有 375 题，集中于实数初等不等式；组合退化不能直接外推到代数、拓扑或程序证明。
  1. 生成器偏差： 固定变换规则可能形成可识别模板，模型经过针对性训练后可提高分数但未获得通用组合能力。
  1. pass@k 预算： 不同论文若使用不同采样数、温度或 Lean 版本，结果不可直接比较；复现需固定完整搜索预算。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Prover diagnosis: Use the seed→type1/type2→mix score ladder to locate weaknesses in rewriting, variable duplication, and multi-step composition.
  1. Composition training: Expand training with the generator but reserve unseen seeds and unseen transformation combinations to prevent template leakage.
  1. Process studies: Compare no-proof, constituent-proof, and natural-language-hint conditions to separate retrieval, planning, and Lean implementation failures.

1. prover 诊断： 用 seed→type1/type2→mix 的阶梯分数定位模型对表面改写、变量复制和多步组合的具体弱点。
  1. 组合训练集： 基于相同生成器扩展训练题，但保留 unseen seeds 与 unseen transformation combinations 作为测试，避免模板泄漏。
  1. 过程研究： 比较不给 proof、给组件 proof 和给自然语言提示三种设置，判断失败发生在检索、规划还是 Lean 实现。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: A 375-task Lean benchmark created by controlled transformations of elementary inequalities to test composition.
  1. Method hook: Seed problems, variable/algebra transformations, Ineq-Mix composition, and constituent-proof counterfactuals.
  1. Data hook: There are 75 seed, 75 type1, 75 type2, 100 mix, and 50 real tasks under Apache-2.0.
  1. Evidence anchor: Even DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B drops about 20% at pass@32.
  1. Reuse decision: Use it diagnostically rather than as large-scale training data, reserving unseen seeds and transformations.

1. 一句话定位： 375 个从基础不等式受控变换得到的 Lean 任务，专门测组合泛化。
  1. 方法抓手： seed、变量/代数变换、Ineq-Mix 组合和组件 proof 反事实实验。
  1. 数据抓手： seed/type1/type2 各 75，mix 100，real 50，Apache-2.0。
  1. 证据锚点： 最稳健的 DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B 在 pass@32 仍约下降 20%。
  1. 复用决定： 适合诊断而非大规模训练；必须保留未见 seed 和变换组合。
